 Order

The petitioners have filed the present petition, inter alia, praying that directions be issued to the respondents for disbursal of the compensation in respect of their land acquired in terms of Award No.10 of 2008-09 DC (NW).

The learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that in alternative the matter be referred under Section 30/31 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 for determining their interest in the acquired land.

Additionally, the petitioners also claim the benefit of the Special Rehabilitation Package (SRP).
2.
The learned counsel appearing for the petitioners submits that the Land Acquisition Collector (LAC) is the necessary party and requires to be arrayed as a respondent in the present petition.
On oral prayer of the learned counsel for the petitioners, the LAC is impleaded as a respondent to the present petition.
